messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content: 我目前無法即時查詢最新的 ATP 或 WTA 排名。建議您直接前往官方網站（ATP 官方網站或 WTA 官方網站）或使用專門的體育新聞平台（如 ESPN、BBC Sport、Sky Sports 等）來查看最新的世界排名。這些來源會即時更新球員的排名、分數和相關統計資訊。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？" (Who is currently ranked number one tennis player?). We need to retrieve current ranking. Use function sports_team_standing? That function is for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual ranking. We can answer based on knowledge: As of 2026, men's ATP ranking #1 is Carlos Alcaraz? Actually as of 2026, maybe it's Carlos Alcaraz or something else. But we don't have up-to-date data. We can say "I don't have real-time data." But we can provide approximate. But we should not hallucinate. We can say "I don't have real-time data, but as of my last update, the top ATP player was ...". But the user likely expects current ranking. We can respond: "I don't have real-time data. Please check ATP/WTA official sites." That is safe.
